description: Skipped the Plaud transcript ingestion step (workflows/plaud-ingest/workflow.md, fire-and-forget Knox spawn) during boot for the second consecutive session, rationalizing it as 'no explicit request, prior sessions show repeated token friction, not treated as blocking.' This is a required Data Source in the boot workflow's INITIALIZATION table, not an optional step.
correction: Plaud ingest should be spawned (fire-and-forget) on every boot per the workflow definition, regardless of prior friction, unless there is a specific blocking condition to report. Repeatedly skipping it based on anticipated friction rather than an actual current-session failure is not a valid reason to omit a required step.
failure_mode: Self-rationalized skip of a mandatory boot step based on a pattern from prior sessions rather than checking current-session conditions — same shape as the standing-authorization failure documented in err-20260716T133503-XFSPE2 (stale reasoning overriding a should-run default).
systemic_fix: Remove discretion from this step: on every boot, actually attempt the Knox/Plaud spawn fire-and-forget rather than pre-emptively deciding to skip it. If it fails or times out, log that as the outcome instead of skipping the attempt. Escalate to Rigby if a structural fix to the plaud-ingest workflow's reliability is warranted.
